start.text:
Hey {user}! 👋 I am {bot_name} 🤖 Your fun companion for groups! Add me to your group and bring it to life with random GIF reactions, playful commands, couple matching and a whole lot of chaos. 🎉 What I can do ├ 🎭 14 GIF reaction commands ├ 💞 Couple of the moment ├ 🎲 A fresh random GIF every single time └ ⚡ Fast, async and always awake
Tap Help below to see everything I know.

help.text:
🤖 {bot_name} — Help 🎉 Fun Commands
{fun_commands}
👑 Owner Commands
/broadcast /stats /cleanup
Most reaction commands work by replying to someone's message. Use the buttons below for details. 💫
help.owner_section: 👑 Owner Commands • /broadcast — reply to any message to send it everywhere -u users only · -g groups only · -f forward · -p pin • /stats — users and groups overview • /cleanup — inactive record report Current reach ├ 👤 Users: {users} └ 👥 Groups: {groups}
